active_candidates.prompt: Create ONE reference-guided full-body character asset of the HUMAN-HOST FLOOD COMBAT FORM from HALO 3, matching the authentic developer presentation image supplied. The input is a two-view reference sheet; output only one single organism, no sheet, labels or second view. Preserve the canonical human Marine host proportions and exact recognizable asymmetry: residual armoured human RIGHT arm and hand, enlarged mutant LEFT arm ending in the several thick folded whip tendrils shown in the reference, swollen yellow-olive fungal upper body, displaced host head drooping toward its right shoulder, small characteristic red-brown sensory fronds at the chest, worn olive Marine armor fragments, camouflage trousers, leg plates and both dark combat boots. Match the restrained original game-model material and color treatment, without inventing additional wounds or battle effects. A hunched idle stance with feet apart and left tendrils resting forward, no attack in progress and no victim. Keep both boots and every tendril tip inside the frame. This is the Halo 3 human combat-form class, not an Elite or Brute host and not a Flood pure form. Deliver exactly ONE character, full body head to feet including every appendage, centered with at least 10 percent transparent empty margin on all sides. New static combat idle pose facing screen RIGHT, about 75 to 85 degrees from frontal, camera at torso height with minimal perspective for a 2D fighting game. Preserve the exact identity, model silhouette, proportions, left/right equipment and materials from the supplied canonical reference; target the named game incarnation without redesign or combining iterations. Crisp high-detail game-rendered finish, even neutral light, true transparent alpha PNG. No floor, background, cast shadow, inset, alternate view, labels, interface or duplicate figures.

active_candidates.prompt: Create one production-quality full-body transparent-background character image of Fred-104 exactly as the attached official Halo 5: Guardians 2015 game render. This is a reference-guided new fighting-game idle combat pose, preserving character identity, anatomical proportions, individual armor geometry, colors, equipment and correct left-right asymmetry. His specific blue-grey CENTURION GEN2 armor with narrow amber visor under the raised segmented brow, broad armored jaw, bulky shoulder armor, subtle yellow trim and cyan identifiers; do not replace this helmet with Master Chief's or generic MJOLNIR. Preserve the reference's large black long rifle, recognizable silhouette, existing fittings and proportions. Repose the complete character to face screen RIGHT, near side-on with only a slight three-quarter view if necessary to retain the distinctive helmet; head, torso, knees and boots all directed right. Stable staggered combat stance, knees flexed mildly, rifle held by exactly two anatomically correct gloved hands across the torso at low ready toward screen right, no firing. Match the high-detail realistic game-render surface language of the reference. One character only, one weapon only; helmet stays closed with no invented face. Full helmet, all armor, both boots and the entire weapon must be visible with generous empty transparent padding on every side (at least 6 percent); choose canvas wide enough for weapon and stance. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no labels, no text, no effects, no duplicates, no decorative border. This image is a new pose of the referenced canonical design, not a redesign.
active_candidates.qa: Référence officielle inspectée ; armure CENTURION bleu gris, repères jaunes/cyan et casque à viseur ambre identifiable. Un personnage et une arme visibles en entier ; deux mains sur l’arme ; orientation vers la droite mais torse encore en trois-quarts. Détails de l’optique du fusil et surfaces occultées dans la source extrapolés ; marge supérieure et inférieure réduite. Revue centrale indépendante de la sortie et du rendu de référence : silhouette fermée CENTURION bleu gris, visière ambre, panneaux jaunes/cyan et dissymétrie des genouillères reconnaissables. Deux bras, deux mains et deux jambes observés sans membre supplémentaire. Both feet, every limb, head extremity, and every carried weapon must be completely visible within the frame, with a comfortable empty transparent margin on every side. Exactly one coherent character, two arms and two legs, species-correct hands and feet, no fused limbs, duplicated equipment or phantom hands. Orthographic-like game camera, neutral studio illumination, sharp metal, matte undersuit and alien skin materials, production concept quality. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND AND ALPHA, including holes between limbs. No scene, ground plane, scenery, cast shadow, smoke, title, label, logo, watermark, UI, border, contact sheet, turnaround or second character. Faithfully preserve the specific supplied original-game design rather than mixing later versions. The fighting stance is a new pose, not a claim of a canonical animation. SUBJECT: ONE of the TWO bonded Mgalekgolo bodies collectively named COLONY, from the official Halo Wars 2 (2017) leader portrait by Jeremy Cook supplied. Select precisely the larger FOREGROUND Hunter on the RIGHT half of this portrait. The smaller Hunter behind him at the left must be entirely absent. This is one body representing the pair in a 2D fighter adaptation, not a claim that Colony is a single being; do not invent an individual name. The selected body's exact official design is the visual authority: very heavy hunched broad silhouette, dark blue-black gunmetal segmented armor, long smooth angular dorsal spines, a sharply pointed angular dark helmet with red luminous strips along the cheek/brow edges, thick bundled brown/purple Lekgolo strands visible around the neck and natural joints, and enormous dark armored shoulders. Crucially KEEP the original asymmetry: the physical RIGHT ARM has the integral heavy CANNON with its round green emitter and green-lit translucent power cylinders, visible toward the LOWER LEFT of the foreground body in the source. The physical LEFT ARM carries the huge SOLID dark metal SHIELD slab visible at the LOWER RIGHT side of the source. The cannon ends in a gun, never a human hand; the shield is one slab, never a second cannon. The shield and cannon must both be distinct and readable in a near-lateral ready stance facing screen right, with both sturdy legs and full armored feet visible below. Keep the exact supplied head, shoulder and cannon design; do not use the separate red Hunter Captain unit design, do not make a cyclops Captain eye, do not use red canisters, no Goliath arms or conventional blue Covenant armor. Complete only the hidden lower legs, feet and cropped dorsal tips using restrained natural continuations of the shown dark Mgalekgolo armor silhouette, without invented motifs or decorative additions. Every spike tip, full cannon, full shield, two legs and two feet safely inside generous clear transparent padding. No second Hunter, no text or portrait background.
